subject: File control entry
notes: kb/Work PB829. The four formats were RENDERED from the printed pages (PDF p342-344 / folios 312-314); every clause of their union is modelled and the residue is DIAGNOSED (COBOL1970, the file-control negative - its residue now follows ORGANIZATION, because words after an ASSIGN operand are further TO operands). The last missing piece is closed (wave 48 W): the ASSIGN TO phrase is the LIST the printed format writes (`assignTarget+`, the ellipsis on the inner brace pair), and which lists are allowable is the 12.4.5.2 SR5 determination DOC-A.1-71 (one operand naming the file, or DISK/PRINTER then one operand), read in ONE place, AssignTargetRule.Resolve; any other list is COBOL2256 BY NAME where it used to be the parse error COBOL0308. Positive 85/pb829_assign_device_class proves DISK "x" and "x" name the same file; negative pb829-assign-target-list (two literals, reject-at all four editions).
